avoid_supplements.name: Phosphodiesterase-5 (PDE-5) inhibitors (sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Combined vasodilation causing severe, potentially life-threatening hypotension
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all PDE-5 inhibitors

avoid_supplements.name: Riociguat (soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Synergistic vasodilation and severe hypotension risk

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate hypotensive effects through vasodilation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; adjust dose if significant hypotension occurs

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn extract
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive hypotension or dizziness

caution_supplements.name: L-arginine
caution_supplements.mechanism: Enhances nitric oxide production, potentiating vasodilation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; may enhance nitrate effects

avoid_foods.name: High-dose phosphodiesterase inhibitor-containing foods (unlikely in standard diet)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Theoretical risk with concentrated herbal supplements containing PDE inhibitors
avoid_foods.action: Review all herbal/supplement ingredients with patient

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive hypotensive effects and increased risk of orthostatic hypotension and syncope
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol consumption; counsel on dizziness/syncope risk

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May counteract therapeutic benefits in heart failure patients
caution_foods.action: Recommend moderate sodium restriction as part of heart disease management

monitoring_notes: Monitor for headache (common nitrate side effect), dizziness, and syncope, particularly with first dose or dose increases. Assess for nitrate tolerance development with continuous dosing and counsel on the importance of a nitrate-free interval (10-14 hours daily) to maintain efficacy.
